maddeler.e:
يهس (form I)
# يَهُسُّ (yahussu) /ja.hus.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of هَسَّ (hassa)
# يُهَسُّ (yuhassu) /ju.has.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of هَسَّ (hassa)
# يَهُسَّ (yahussa) /ja.hus.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of هَسَّ (hassa)
# يُهَسَّ (yuhassa) /ju.has.sa/: third-person masc
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
